name: Futbobo
storyline: Starting at age 12, the player chooses a personal background and enters a youth academy, trying to earn a professional debut between ages 16 and 18. Every season brings performance results, choices and consequences shaped by that origin. Transfers, loans, national-team call-ups, fictional rivals, injuries, fame, money, sponsors and life away from the pitch can turn the same prospect into completely different people. A career may end as a forgotten talent, a respected professional, a club idol or a record-breaking football legend.
summary: Futbobo is a free, mobile-first football career simulator for browsers, Android and Windows. Create a player at age 12, develop through a youth academy, choose any of 12 positions and build a unique career across 637 clubs, 36 leagues and 139 national teams. Seasons combine performance simulation with choices and consequences, transfers, loans, finances, sponsors, injuries, rivalries, social life, national-team tournaments and individual awards. Decisive finals and a standalone World Cup mode can be played as a button-football game with physics, penalties and goal replays.
